en:
Geez...
Everyone's saying the same thing.

It's not okay to lump them together just 
because they've both <CLT=cltSTRONG>killed<CLT=cltNORMAL> someone.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kaito for a while?

Kaede and Kirumi...did both kill someone...
But that doesn't make them <CLT=cltSTRONG>murderous fiends<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some quiet time alone
with Kaito...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I grew a little closer today.
